Chosen: (b) — the fragment breaks off mid-sentence and is a merge artifact (reported upstream as #186, fix PR #187; wg bead mimid-1wgh.37.96). requestConsent and updateConsent answer 202 Accepted on receipt, including a cancel with no matching request; 404 for an unknown local user stays per decision mimid-1wgh.7.36 (-07 still allows it).
